title: Infinite Scroll
statement:
Implement infinite scroll (also called lazy loading) with pagination. This is a common pattern in modern web apps for handling large datasets while maintaining good performance.

Your implementation should:
1. Detect when user scrolls near bottom of page
2. Automatically load next page of data
3. Append new items to existing list
4. Show loading indicator while fetching
5. Handle errors gracefully
6. Prevent duplicate requests (debounce/throttle)
7. Support both viewport and scrollable container detection
constraints: Must use Intersection Observer API (not scroll event listener)
Must show loading state while fetching
Must handle empty states and error conditions
Must work with dynamic item heights
Must maintain scroll position on new page load
complexity: Time: O(n) for rendering items, Space: O(n) for storing loaded items, Intersection Observer operations: O(1)
commonMistakes: Using scroll event listener instead of Intersection Observer (performance issue)
Not preventing duplicate requests when user scrolls fast
Not handling loading state, causing multiple simultaneous requests
Removing old items instead of appending (losing data)
Using array index as key (causes rendering issues on data changes)
Setting sentinel element at wrong position in DOM
